defects.description: The availability check marks its status region aria-busy=true before the update and never removes the attribute. The visible results are correct, but assistive technology may keep treating the region as still updating and withhold the new content.

relatedElements.note: Clears aria-busy after rendering the results.

defects.expectedBehaviour: A busy state is cleared once the update is complete, so the new content can be announced.
defects.actualBehaviour: aria-busy=true remains on the status region after the results have rendered.
defects.userImpact: Screen-reader users may never hear the result count even though it is visible on screen.

wcag.note: A status update may be withheld because the region is marked busy indefinitely.

detection.note: The attribute is only observable after the asynchronous update.
